premises.text: Consumers struggle to make good-quality coffee at home and spend about $5/day in shops, while single-serve pods are wasteful, expensive, and stale, and home makers show little innovation
premises.evidence_span: it's kind of hard to make a good quality coffee at home

premises.text: The Spin Coffee Maker uses patented centrifugal-force brewing that manages barista-like brew elements without pods, filters, or wasteful materials, and spins out dry grounds for clean disposal
premises.evidence_span: The Spin Coffee Maker uses patented centrifugal force technology to brew your coffee

premises.text: The connected machine and app auto-replenish fresh beans from a marketplace of local coffee roasters via a sensor-triggered bean list
premises.evidence_span: The beans get ordered automatically from a marketplace for local coffee roasters

premises.text: Business model takes margins on machines and a cut of every marketplace bean order
premises.evidence_span: we're going to make margins on the machines and the beans

domains.name: centrifugal Spin maker and bean marketplace

value.text: Third-wave quality coffee at home with single-serve convenience and no pod waste, without coffee downtime
value.evidence_span: combines the quality of the third wave coffee roasters with the convenience of a single serve pod system

causal_links.evidence_span: there is very low innovation in the coffee maker market
we're going to solve the biggest problem in coffee history, coffee downtime
Internet of Things meets coffee marketplace
